topics.description: The FBI has assigned 260 staffers to investigate the 2020 election in Fulton County, Georgia. This investigation is focused on examining Fulton County's 2020 election records.
topics.reason: The investigation is significant because it involves a large number of analysts and is focused on a key battleground state in the 2020 presidential election.

topics.description: A Medicaid fraud crackdown has brought panic to patients and providers in Eden Prairie, Minnesota. The crackdown is part of a larger effort to combat Medicaid fraud in the state.
topics.reason: The Medicaid fraud crackdown is significant because it highlights the ongoing issue of healthcare fraud in the United States.
